intro_messages.speaker: Minister Hylas
intro_messages.message_fr: Le val des arbres en fleur.

intro_messages.speaker: Minister Hylas
intro_messages.message:
Other than that singular piece of information, I regret to report that Urza Fastik remains as recalcitrant as the day we first arrived.

Whether “The Vale of Blossoming Trees” refers to the source of his dark powers, the location of another Urza brother, or something else entirely, I cannot say.
intro_messages.message_fr:
À part cette singulière information, je suis au regret de vous annoncer que Urza Fastik est tout aussi récalcitrant qu'au premier jour.

« Le Val des Arbres en Fleur » peut faire référence à la source de ses sombres pouvoirs, la position d'un autre frère Urza, ou tout autre chose. Je ne peux le savoir avec certitude.

intro_messages.speaker: Deoran
intro_messages.message: The vale... isn’t that an Aethenwood exclave? I can’t imagine the Aethenwood elves would have anything to do with necromancy, or ever offer aid to bandits... I hear they’re aloof even with regards to the king. Can we not learn more from our captive?
intro_messages.message_fr: Le val... n'est ce pas dans l'enclave de la forêt d'Aethen ? Je peine à imaginer que les elfes d'Aethen ont à voir avec la nécromancie, ou même offrant de l'aide à des bandits... J'ai entendu qu'ils se tenaient plutôt à l'écart, ignorant même les invitations du roi. On ne peux pas en apprendre plus sur notre prisonnier ?

intro_messages.speaker: Sir Gerrick
intro_messages.message: I say we’re treatin’ him too gentle. Man like Fastik — he’s plenty used to roughing it. Lives are at stake, an’ too much coddling ain’t getting us nowhere.
intro_messages.message_fr: Moi j'dis que nous l'traitons trop gentiment. Les hommes comme Fastik ont la peau dure. Des vies sont en jeu, et le cuisiner gentiment ne nous mènera à rien.

intro_messages.speaker: Minister Hylas
intro_messages.message: I fear there is a corruption in his soul, darker than even my light can illuminate. Now deprived of the dark magic that once suffused him, his very mind has begun to fade away.
intro_messages.message_fr: Je crains qu'il n'y ait de la corruption dans son âme, plus obscure que ce que ne peut éclairer ma lumière. Maintenant privé de la magie noire qui l'avait submergé, son esprit a commencé à s'effacer.

intro_messages.speaker: Minister Hylas
intro_messages.message: Even were he willing, I am not sure he remembers anything other than what he has already told us.
intro_messages.message_fr: Même s'il le voulait, je ne suis pas sûr qu'il se rappellerait d'autre chose que ce qu'il nous a déjà dit.

intro_messages.speaker: Mari
intro_messages.message: Hey, everyone. I’m done cleaning up the last of Fastik’s mess, but no trace of the other two brothers.
intro_messages.message_fr: Salut tout le monde ! J'ai fini de ranger le bazar qui servait de campement à Fastik, mais pas la moindre trace des deux autres frères.

intro_messages.speaker: Mari
intro_messages.message: Thanks, Hylas. Shouldn’t there be a duke or prince or something around here? How did things get this bad?
intro_messages.message_fr: Merci, Hylas. N'y a-t-il pas un duc, ou un prince, ou quelque chose comme ça par ici ? Comment les choses ont-elles tourné si mal ?

intro_messages.speaker: Sir Gerrick
intro_messages.message: Aye, officially these lands belong to Prince Arand; King Garard’s younger brother. Arand’s been tryin’ to build the place up. Last time he visited, His Highness said our home might someday be called the Jewel of the South!
intro_messages.message_fr: Et bien, officiellement, ces terres sont la propriété du prince Arand, le plus jeune frère du roi Garard. Arand essaie de développer un peu l'coin. La dernière fois qu'il nous a honoré d'une visite, sa grandeur a dit qu'not' chez nous pourrait bien un jour être appelé les Joyaux du Sud !

intro_messages.speaker: Sir Gerrick
intro_messages.message: But the kingdom is large, the prince has many holdings, an’ today Westin be but a small town. These Urza outlaws ha’ always been a nuisance, but once they somehow started raisin’ the dead things got out of hand, fast.
intro_messages.message_fr: Mais l'royaume est grand, le prince a beaucoup d'affaires à gérer, et Westin n'est qu'une petite ville aujourd'hui. Ces brigands d'Urza ont toujours été une nuisance, mais dès qu'ils ont commencé à r'lever les morts, les choses ont vite mal tourné.

intro_messages.speaker: Minister Hylas
intro_messages.message: We dispatched messengers carrying word of our plight, only to have them intercepted on the road or waylaid at river crossings. You are the first contact we have had with the crown in some time, sirs Mari and Deoran. With your aid, we can defeat these outlaws and cleanse their undead.
intro_messages.message_fr: Nous avons envoyé des messagers pour avertir de notre détresse, mais ils se sont fait intercepter sur la route ou arrêter au passage des rivières. Vous êtes le premier contact que nous ayons eu avec la couronne depuis un petit bout de temps, Mari et Deoran. Avec votre aide, nous pouvons vaincre ces hors-la-loi et nettoyer ces morts-vivants.

intro_messages.speaker: Deoran
intro_messages.message: Well, if we don’t have any other leads, then we’ll need to investigate this “Vale of Blossoming Trees” and hope it’s neither misdirection nor a trap. Sirs, do I have your permissions to take the infantry on a sortie?
intro_messages.message_fr: Et bien, puisque nous n'avons pas d'autres indices, nous allons devoir investiguer dans ce « Val des Arbres en Fleur » et espérer que ce n'est ni une fausse piste ni un piège. Messieurs, ai-je votre permission d'emmener l'infanterie pour une petite sortie ?

intro_messages.speaker: Sir Gerrick
intro_messages.message: Offerin’ to command the mission? Brave lad, but you shan’t have to go alone. Two o’ us officers will need to stay here and watch th’ town, but at least one o’ us should come with ye to help fight.
intro_messages.message_fr: Z'êtes volontaire pour commander la mission ? Brave garçon, mais vous ne devriez pas y aller tout seul. Deux d'entre nous doivent rester pour défendre la ville, mais au moins un officier devrait aller avec vous.

intro_messages.speaker: Sir Gerrick
intro_messages.message: Take yer pick — either me, Minister Hylas, or tha’ Mari o’ yers. You don’t know much about how each of us fight yet, so ask and we’ll tell!
intro_messages.message_fr: Faites vot' choix — moi-même, révérend Hylas, ou cet' Mari qu'vous nous avez amené. Vous ne savez pas grand chose de comment chacun d'nous se bat, alors demandez-nous et nous vous l'dirons.

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: Hey, rookie. I’m all out of quintains, so if you want more bruises you’ll have to find another inanimate object to fight.

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: ...but I guess you’re asking about my skills, not yours. You never did get a chance to see me fight.

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: Hey, rookie. Yeah, you never did get a chance to see me fight.

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: Well, I’m a survivor. Fast-moving, light on my feet; good at evading, good at stabbing. Hard to pin down, whether in an attack or in an escape.

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: Mari has unusually high terrain defenses (her chance to evade enemy attacks). Her skirmisher ability lets her ignore enemies’ Zone of Control — she can move freely around enemy units without being stopped.

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: Got a pretty good sling too, ’cuz there aren’t many ranged weapons that can be loaded one-handed. Altogether, I’ll bet I could outlast both Hylas and Gerrick in a 1-on-1. And you too, but that goes without saying.

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: And... if you come with me you’ll actually help fight? No more training, or observing, or running off right before the battle starts?

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: Of course. Highwaymen are one thing, but necromancy is serious business. I just thought... well, after losing one arm to undead in the Estmarks, I hoped I was done dealing with this sort of thing.

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: I already told you, didn’t I? Pay attention this time — I’ve got a sword and sling, skill at evading attacks, and can move freely around enemies without being stopped.

a.speaker: Minister Hylas
a.message: I am a man of medicine, Lieutenant Deoran. The light within me can heal adjacent units just as quickly as can resting in a village. This doesn’t stack with healing from villages or other healers, however.

a.speaker: Minister Hylas
a.message: In ranged combat, I also wield a highly accurate magical attack. Magical attacks always have a high chance to hit and are unaffected by terrain, making them ideal against evasive or fortified enemies.

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: I don’t mean to be rude, but... your leg looks badly injured. If you have healing magic, shouldn’t you have been able to cure it?

a.speaker: Minister Hylas
a.message:
Born twisted, I’m afraid. At the time there was no healer in Westin, and the bones set poorly.

Such was the greater part of my motivation for traveling to the Isle of Alduin and studying the arcane arts — an opportunity to return home and offer to others the services that I never had.

a.speaker: Minister Hylas
a.message: I’ve long-ago accepted my impairment. But as my potential commander, you should know that it does somewhat slow my movement on the battlefield, even more so than is Sir Gerrick by his armor.

a.speaker: Minister Hylas
a.message: Forgotten already? I can heal adjacent units for a moderate amount every turn. I wield a ranged magical attack that is highly accurate, irrespective of the terrain my opponent occupies.

a.speaker: Sir Gerrick
a.message: Well lad, I’m a monster in melee, if you’ll forgive me the brag. My glaive hits harder than any spear, an’ my crushin’ shield bash can slow enemies.

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: Slowed enemies move at half speed and deal half damage.

a.speaker: Sir Gerrick
a.message: An’ while my armor may be heavy an’ cumbersome, it also gives me great resistance against bladed or piercing weapons. If you need someone t’ break an enemy line, I’m your man.

a.speaker: Sir Gerrick
a.message: Well, like I said, I’ve got great damage resistance on account o’ me heavy armor, an’ I can slow enemies t’ halve both their speed an’ damage. Try not t’ forget this time!
